description: Change Tracking ops: enablement, retention, auto-cleanup, tracked tables, current/min-valid version and version window. Collector: mssql_cdc_change_tracking (300s).

panels.description: CT DBs with version window >= Window Warn.

targets.expr: count(mssql_change_tracking_version_window{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} >= $window_warn and mssql_change_tracking_version_window >= 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: CT DBs with version window >= Window Warn.

panels.description: CT-enabled DBs with automatic cleanup disabled.

targets.expr: count(mssql_change_tracking_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 1 and mssql_change_tracking_auto_cleanup_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: CT-enabled DBs with automatic cleanup disabled.

panels.description: CT enabled at DB level but no visible tracked tables (or metadata -1).

targets.expr: count(mssql_change_tracking_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 1 and (mssql_change_tracking_table_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 0 or mssql_change_tracking_table_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} < 0)) or vector(0)
